map.由连杆质量、长度与角度求重力扭矩: Find the gravity torque from link mass, length and angle
map.输入质量 m、臂长 L、角度 θ、g，求关节重力扭矩。: Enter the mass m, arm length L, angle θ and g to get the joint gravity torque.
map.📖 查看「由连杆质量、长度与角度求重力扭矩 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the gravity torque from link mass, length and angle"
map.τ = m·g·L·cosθ（水平时最大）。: τ = m·g·L·cosθ, a maximum when the arm is horizontal.
map.水平伸展臂重力平衡。: Gravity balance of a horizontally extended arm.
map.平衡弹簧/配重设计。: Design of balancing springs and counterweights.
map.5kg、臂长 0.3m、水平伸展: 5 kg, arm length 0.3 m, horizontally extended
map.τ=m·g·L·cosθ=5×9.81×0.3×1=14.7 N·m（θ=0 水: τ = m·g·L·cosθ = 5 x 9.81 x 0.3 x 1 = 14.7 N·m, the maximum at θ = 0, horizontally extended.
map.cos90=0 → 重力矩为 0，无需补偿。: cos 90° = 0, so the gravity torque vanishes and no compensation is needed.
map.臂与水平方向夹角；θ=0（水平）时重力矩最大，θ=90°（竖直）时为零。: The angle between the arm and the horizontal; gravity torque peaks at θ = 0 (horizontal) and is zero at θ = 90° (vertical).
map.各连杆重力矩求和，质心法向距离累加。: Sum the gravity torque of each link, adding up the normal distance of each centre of mass.
map.τ = m·g·L·cosθ（θ 自水平方向量起，θ=0 水平时最大）。: τ = m·g·L·cosθ (θ measured from horizontal; maximum at θ=0, horizontal).
map.重力补偿扭矩：τ = m·g·L·cos(θ×π/180)（N·m，θ 为杆件与: Gravity compensation torque: τ = m·g·L·cos(θ×π/180) (N·m, θ the angle between the link and horizontal in °, converted to radians for the calculation); linked value: a torque curve is drawn across the sweep angle (__gctSweep). Validation: no strict validation; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; θ = 0° (horizontal) gives the maximum torque and θ = 90° (vertical) zero, varying with cosθ.
map.L 必须是关节到质心的距离，不是连杆总长。若输入均匀杆总长 L_total，质心: L must be the joint-to-center-of-mass distance, not the link total length. For a uniform rod of total length L_total, the center of mass is at L_total/2, so enter L=L_total/2; for an end-point load, enter the joint-to-load distance. This page uses τ=m·g·L·cosθ and ignores friction, transmission and multi-link coupling.
